title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 306 River Street in Tilden, Texas, as the "Tilden Veterans Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 306 River Street in Tilden, Texas, as the "Tilden Veterans Post Office."

summary.headline: A law renames the Tilden, Texas post office at 306 River Street the "Tilden Veterans Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Tilden, Texas, an official new name. The building is at 306 River Street and will be called the "Tilden Veterans Post Office." It is a naming change only and does not alter how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 13, 2018.
